chapters.label: Munich, live
chapters.text: Munich, 2024: the Euros begin! Germany, in white, play Scotland. Gündogan finds Havertz, who lays it back to Jamal Musiala. A quick chop past a defender... and bang, into the roof of the net!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Small, quick touches: one to control, one chop sideways, away from the defender.

chapters.label: From behind
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the chop makes a gap, and the net shakes! What a finish!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: use small, quick touches, and change direction to squeeze between defenders.
